topics.title: Howard's Confusing Trivia and Sweaty Hand
topics.summary: During a radio show, Howard recounts running into Chris Rock and shaking his hand, resulting in a sweaty grip. He then engages in a series of bizarre trivia questions with callers, including attempting to decipher the meaning of 'cake eater,' struggling with historical facts like who wrote ‘I Have A Dream,’ and incorrectly identifying December 7th as the date for Pearl Harbor.

topics.title: Lou’s Trivia Troubles
topics.summary: During a trivia game, Lou repeatedly fails to answer questions correctly about state capitals and the number of Great Lakes, prompting frustration among other participants who attempt to guide his responses while he makes several incorrect assertions. He also struggles with concepts like leap years and the question regarding how many days are in a leap year.

topics.title: Clinton Explains Jeopardy and Baseball
topics.summary: During a rapid-fire discussion involving trivia questions about Alexander Graham Bell and Mark McGuire’s home run record, callers debate whether President Clinton knows details regarding investigations into his affairs. The conversation shifts to speculation about Hillary Clinton's future and ultimately concludes with an admission of wanting to resign from public life while discussing baseball star Mark McGuire hitting a home run and the possibility of resigning for personal reasons.”}id: 1789342657

topics.title: Political Rumors and Scandals – Runoff Election
topics.summary: The broadcast features a chaotic discussion of various political figures including Pataki, the Liberal Party candidate, and former President Clinton. Claims are made about voter manipulation, Monica Lewinsky’s involvement in personal relationships, accusations against columnist Richard Gutwilegg regarding sexual assault, and an air conditioner repairman winning a runoff election after defeating a deceased mayoral nominee.

topics.title: Bababoo's Evaluation - Uncomfortable Details
topics.summary: During a radio show, hosts discuss an evaluation of Bababoo, recounting bizarre suggestions like a new haircut and breast implants with little evidence. The conversation quickly devolves into uncomfortable tangents about hygiene issues, underwear preferences, and misinterpretations of Regis Philbin’s behavior, revealing no logical connection.

topics.title: Yankees Sale & Cow Plastic Crisis
topics.summary: The New York Yankees are reportedly being sold to Chuck Dolan for approximately half a billion dollars while in India, a Hindu guru is campaigning against plastic bags due to their impact on cows. Thousands of cows die annually from choking on discarded material, highlighting an unusual environmental concern and prompting calls for government action.
